research_scope: First-party provider-copying rules for two exact bibliographic target objects, not access to the source texts and not independent early-impression evidence.

observations: Ordinary copy service is NOT accepted for undigitized and unmicrofilmed stitched books; full-page outsourced digitization applications are a different service.
Individual applications for full-page digitization are not accepted; request must be sent through an affiliated academic/public library.
Check the book's OPAC electronic image icon and separately search micro-type matching/near-matching items before deciding to apply.
If reproduction or publication on web is intended, separate materials-use permission is needed.
ILL requests are accepted from libraries; stitched classics are specially routed, not ordinary loanable books.
For already microfilmed rare/stitched books, reproduction may be from the microfilm reader/printer; item-level microfilm existence remains unverified.
Material type 和装古書 and 貴重 require access procedure; category for item10076865665 requires first-party OPAC confirmation.
Digitized images, where present, are linked through the item catalogue and should be checked before original-handling requests.

objects.corrected_prior_12uh_action: Earlier draft suggestion 'request only a limited leaf span' cannot be treated as an available standard Tsukuba copy service for an unmicrofilmed/undigitized stitched book; first verify existing surrogate and service category, otherwise consider institutional all-pages application.

observations: NDL provides a fee-based remotely requested copy service for registered individuals/institutions; unregistered users can ask a participating local library.
A book request must identify the book and the passage/page or article title; unidentified target folio is not enough without a separate reference/table-of-contents locating step.
Some Rare Books and Old Materials requests may require a mailed special permission application; never infer this item is automatically copyable.
When microfilm or a digitized surrogate exists, NDL ordinarily reproduces from that surrogate instead of handling the original.
Overseas service conditions can differ; no foreign delivery or PDF receipt eligibility is established for this specific book.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Provider reproduction procedures do not establish a physical edition or original image.
A derivative digitized or microfilm copy cannot receive an independent ancient-witness vote solely because a new library fulfills a request.
Service-level fee schedule does not establish any item-specific cost or permission.
